nodes.text: Synthetic claim CLM-2041 is open for the same covered loss in the reserve and payment applications.
Reserve Ledger snapshot 2026-06-10: CLM-2041 outstanding indemnity reserve = 75000 USD. This ledger is authoritative for reserve balance.
Payment Platform snapshot 2026-06-10: CLM-2041 paid-to-date = 62000 USD; remaining payment authority = 6000 USD. This platform is authoritative for issued and authorized payments.

The daily reconciliation runbook instructs an analyst to export RESERVE_BALANCE.csv and PAYMENT_REGISTER.csv, copy both into Reconciliation.xlsx, and email exceptions. No API link, shared owner, or immutable reconciliation log is defined.
The 2026-06-10 workbook shows a 7000 USD unexplained difference for CLM-2041; the analyst marked it 'follow up' without a linked resolution record.
Synthetic claim CLM-7813 is open and is keyed as CLM-7813 in both financial applications.
Reserve Ledger v12 lists CLM-7813 with a 120000 USD total incurred reserve after an adjuster update dated 2026-06-30.

Disbursement Console v8 lists CLM-7813 with 90000 USD payment authority. Reserve changes are not received as events; a finance coordinator manually types the new reserve into the console's review sheet.

The month-end procedure says Finance owns a spreadsheet comparison between the reserve ledger and disbursement console. Corrections are communicated by email and the procedure does not retain before-and-after values.
